preconditions.description: The lengths of S1 and S2 must be equal.
The length of S1 and S2 must be between 1 and 31.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S1) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S2)
preconditions.description: Both S1 and S2 must consist of lower-case English letters.

postconditions.description: The function must return True if S2 is a scrambled form of S1, otherwise False.
